## Consolidate

```go
func (s *StakingService) Consolidate(ctx context.Context, chainDescriptor ConsolidateChainDescriptor, body *MergeStakeAccountsRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*MergeStakeAccountsResponse, error)
```

`POST /staking/chains/{chainDescriptor}/consolidate` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Consolidate staking positions (ETH validator consolidation)**

Consolidates the source staking position into the destination, merging the balance into the destination and closing the source position once complete. Both positions must be from the same vault account (i.e. same withdrawal credentials).  On chain, this translates into a consolidation transaction, where the  source validator is consolidated into the destination validator.  Supported chains: Ethereum (ETH) only.
Endpoint Permission: Owner, Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
**Note:** This endpoint is currently in beta and might be subject to changes.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chainDescriptor` | path | [`ConsolidateChainDescriptor`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ConsolidateChainDescriptor) | yes | Protocol identifier for the staking operation (e.g., ETH). |

**Request body:** [`*MergeStakeAccountsRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#MergeStakeAccountsRequest)

**Returns:** [`*MergeStakeAccountsResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#MergeStakeAccountsResponse)

## Stake

```go
func (s *StakingService) Stake(ctx context.Context, chainDescriptor ChainDescriptor, body *StakeRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*StakeResponse, error)
```

`POST /staking/chains/{chainDescriptor}/stake` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Initiate or add to existing stake**

Creates a new staking position and returns its unique ID. For Ethereum compounding validator (EIP-7251): when the 'id' of an existing compounding validator position is provided, adds to that position; otherwise creates a new position. For Ethereum legacy validator: creates a new position regardless of existing delegations. For Cosmos chains and Ethereum liquid staking (Lido): automatically add to existing positions for the same validator provider and same vault account if one exists, otherwise create a new position. For Solana and Polygon (MATIC/POL): always create new positions regardless of existing delegations.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chainDescriptor` | path | [`ChainDescriptor`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ChainDescriptor) | yes | Protocol identifier for the stake staking operation (e.g., ATOM_COS/AXL/CELESTIA). |

**Request body:** [`*StakeRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#StakeRequest)

**Returns:** [`*StakeResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#StakeResponse)

## Withdraw

```go
func (s *StakingService) Withdraw(ctx context.Context, chainDescriptor ChainDescriptor, body *WithdrawRequest, opts ...RequestOption) error
```

`POST /staking/chains/{chainDescriptor}/withdraw` · rate-limit category: `write`

**Withdraw staked funds**

Withdraws funds that have completed the unbonding period. Typically requires the position to be deactivated first (unstake → unbond → withdraw). Amount and timing vary by chain protocol.

Partial withdrawal is supported for ETH compounding validators (EIP-7251/Pectra) and Cosmos chains via the optional 'amount' field. For ETH compounding validators, the remaining balance must be at least 32 ETH after the withdrawal. For all other chains, omitting 'amount' withdraws the entire available balance.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chainDescriptor` | path | [`ChainDescriptor`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ChainDescriptor) | yes | Protocol identifier for the withdraw staking operation (e.g., ATOM_COS/ETH/STETH_ETH). |

**Request body:** [`*WithdrawRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#WithdrawRequest)

**Returns:** only an `error`.

| `pageSize` | query | `int32` | yes | Number of results per page. When provided, the response returns a paginated object with {data, next}. If omitted, all results are returned as an array. |

| `params.PageCursor` | query | `string` |  | Cursor for the next page of results. Use the value from the 'next' field in the previous response. |

## GetPositionRelatedTransactions

```go
func (s *StakingService) GetPositionRelatedTransactions(ctx context.Context, id string, pageSize int32, params *GetPositionRelatedTransactionsParams, opts ...RequestOption) (*StakingPositionRelatedTransactionsPaginatedResponse, error)
```

`GET /staking/positions/{id}/related_transactions` · rate-limit category: `query`

**List related transactions for a position**

Returns enriched transaction history for a staking position with cursor-based pagination. Includes in-flight transactions with status pending. The in-flight transaction is always returned first; completed and failed history is ordered by the order parameter.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | `string` | yes | Unique identifier of the staking position. |
| `pageSize` | query | `int32` | yes | Number of results per page (minimum: 1, maximum: 100). |
| `params.PageCursor` | query | `string` |  | Cursor for the next page of results. Use the value from the 'next' field in the previous response. |
| `params.Order` | query | [`GetPositionRelatedTransactionsOrder`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#GetPositionRelatedTransactionsOrder) |  | ASC / DESC ordering for completed/failed history (default DESC). The in-flight transaction is always returned first. |

**Returns:** [`*StakingPositionRelatedTransactionsPaginatedResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#StakingPositionRelatedTransactionsPaginatedResponse)
